findings.title: Layout editor: the pipe a user clicks to remove is a 2.75-5.75 px hit band, under F1's 24/44 px floor in every cell
findings.claim: In the card's layout editor (setup page, editing on), every drawn pipe -- the target the card says is clicked to remove a connection -- takes the pointer only within a band of at most 2.75 px at 375 px, 3.25 px at 768 px and 5.75 px at 1280 px normal to the pipe, so 576 of 576 pipe targets over the 144 renders of layout_editing_dragged/tidy x de,en,sv x 3 viewports x light/dark x motion x pointer are under D4-criteria F1's 24 px (44 px coarse) floor.
findings.mechanism: cardStyleBlock widens pipes in editing mode only to `stroke-width: 3.5` viewBox units and relies on the painted stroke (pointer-events visiblePainted) as the hit area; there is no transparent wide hit path as the slots (`.slot-hit`) and ports (`.layout-port-hit`, 30.5 px median by the same scan) have. The SVG scales down with the card, so the band shrinks to 2.75 px on a phone.

evidence.unit: pipe targets (of 576) whose elementFromPoint band normal to the pipe at its midpoint is under 24 px (44 px coarse)
evidence.machine: box B9, 4 vCPU, Chromium 158.0.8127.18 (playwright 1.65.0 lock, rev 1254), headless shell

findings.proposed_fix_scope: Draw a transparent wide hit path (stroke-width sized from _targetMinPx() in viewBox units, pointer-events: stroke) beside each editing pipe, as .slot-hit and .layout-port-hit do; keep the visible stroke as is.

findings.title: Chart tooltip with a shared-step line runs 20.6 px past the bottom of its chart at 375 px: fitWhy trims only the idle explanation
findings.claim: Hovering a shared heating/hot-water step in the expanded chart at 375x812 under a fine pointer shows a 201.9 px tooltip in a chart whose box ends 20.6 px above the tooltip's bottom, in 12 of 12 such renders (de, en, sv x light/dark x reduce/no-preference), while no tooltip_hover render spills (0 of 72).
findings.mechanism: fitWhy(tt, chartHeight - 16) keeps the tooltip inside its chart only by removing `.tt-why` items; a shared-step tooltip carries `.tt-shared` and `.tt-reason` prose and no `.tt-why`, so fitWhy returns at `if (!why) return;` with the box still taller than the chart, and the box (z-index 5, chartwrap overflow visible) paints over what sits under the chart.

findings.title: Plan editor slot targets at 375 px: 147 slot-hit rects under F1's floor (min 17.7 px), 99 failing WCAG 2.5.8's spacing exception too
findings.claim: In the expanded plan editor at 375x812, slotHitExtents leaves 147 of the `.slot-hit` targets rendered across the 810 light/reduce renders of all 45 card_drift states x de,en,sv x 3 viewports x fine/coarse under D4-criteria F1's floor (24 px, 44 px coarse; minimum 17.7 px) in 15 states, and 99 of them have another slot target within 12 px of their centre, so WCAG 2.5.8's spacing exception does not rescue them either; 768 and 1280 px count 0.
findings.mechanism: slotHitExtents grows each target to minTargetX (= _targetMinPx() in viewBox units) and then resolves residual overlap by putting the shared edge between the two inks, shrinking both below the floor ('the boxed-in case'); a slot at the plot edge cannot grow outward either (history_unavailable: 19.9 px against plotR). The card accepts this as WCAG's spacing exception, but an undersized target abutting another target fails that exception's 24 px circle test, and F1 as the owner wrote it has no exception.

Needs a design seat (it trades against the no-overlap rule P9-rca4).
